descriptionZh: 以杜松子为主香的金酒，是多数经典鸡尾酒（如马天尼、内格罗尼）的基酒骨架。
descriptionEn: Juniper-forward botanical spirit, the backbone of martinis, negronis and most classic stirred/shaken cocktails.

descriptionZh: 美国玉米为主的威士忌，香草焦糖桶味浓郁，是 Old Fashioned 与 Manhattan 的常见基酒。
descriptionEn: Corn-dominant American whiskey with sweet vanilla and caramel oak notes, the standard base for Old Fashioned and many Manhattan-style drinks.

descriptionZh: 以黑麦为主的威士忌，辛辣干燥，是 Manhattan、Sazerac 的传统基酒。
descriptionEn: Spicy, drier American whiskey traditionally used in Manhattans, Sazeracs, and other spirit-forward classics.

descriptionZh: 谷物与麦芽调和的苏格兰威士忌，Rusty Nail 与 Penicillin 的常选。
descriptionEn: Blend of malt and grain Scotch, common in Rusty Nail and Penicillin for approachable malt character.

descriptionZh: 泥煤烟熏强烈的艾雷岛单一麦芽，常在 Penicillin 上方做浮酒。
descriptionEn: Heavily peated single malt from Islay, typically floated atop a Penicillin to add a smoky finish.

descriptionZh: 三次蒸馏、质地顺滑的爱尔兰威士忌，调鸡尾酒时常作波本的轻量替代。
descriptionEn: Triple-distilled, smooth and light, often used as a softer substitute for bourbon in classic templates.

descriptionZh: 中性无味的高度烈酒，常用于 Moscow Mule、Espresso Martini 等希望凸显其他风味的配方。
descriptionEn: Neutral high-proof spirit, used when the recipe wants other ingredients to lead, e.g. Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini.

descriptionZh: 清淡甘蔗香的白朗姆，Daiquiri、Mojito、Mai Tai 短饮的常选基酒。
descriptionEn: Light, cane-forward rum essential for Daiquiri, Mojito and the rum base of a Mai Tai.

descriptionZh: 糖蜜风味浓郁、桶味较重的深色朗姆，Dark 'n' Stormy、Hurricane 的经典基酒。
descriptionEn: Molasses-rich, oak-aged rum used in Dark 'n' Stormy, Hurricane and other tiki classics.

descriptionZh: 近乎焦糖化的深色糖蜜朗姆，Jungle Bird、Corn 'n' Oil 的灵魂基酒。
descriptionEn: Deeply caramelised molasses rum, the soul of Jungle Bird and Corn 'n' Oil.

descriptionZh: 酒精度 69-75% 的过酒精度朗姆，tiki 类配方少量使用以提供酒体骨架。
descriptionEn: High-proof (69-75% ABV) rum added in small amounts to tiki recipes for spirit backbone.

descriptionZh: 未经橡木桶陈年的龙舌兰，柑橘与胡椒香气明亮，Margarita、Paloma 的标准基酒。
descriptionEn: Unaged 100% agave spirit with bright citrus and pepper notes, the standard base for Margarita and Paloma.

descriptionZh: 短期橡木桶陈年的龙舌兰，桶味柔顺而不失柑橘底色。
descriptionEn: Short-oak-aged tequila, soft vanilla oak on top of cooked agave.

descriptionZh: 烟熏泥煤味的梅斯卡尔酒，Naked & Famous、Division Bell 的核心基酒。
descriptionEn: Smoky, earthy agave spirit, the defining base of Naked & Famous and Division Bell.

descriptionZh: 法国干邑产区的葡萄白兰地，Sidecar、Between the Sheets、Vieux Mot 的高档基酒。
descriptionEn: French grape brandy from Cognac, the elegant base for Sidecar, Between the Sheets and Vieux Mot.

descriptionZh: 秘鲁/智利的无陈年葡萄烈酒，Pisco Sour 的灵魂基酒。
descriptionEn: Unaged Peruvian grape brandy, the soul of the Pisco Sour.

descriptionZh: 美国苹果白兰地，Jack Rose 等历史名方中的传统基酒。
descriptionEn: American apple-based spirit, the historic base for the Jack Rose.

descriptionZh: 意大利红色苦味开胃酒，Negroni、Boulevardier 的核心利口酒。
descriptionEn: Italian red bitter aperitivo, the defining bitter liqueur of the Negroni and Boulevardier.

descriptionZh: 比金巴利更柔和、偏橙香的意大利开胃酒，Spritz 与 Paper Plane 的关键利口酒。
descriptionEn: Softer, orange-leaning Italian bitter used in Aperol Spritz and Paper Plane.

descriptionZh: 加香加糖的红葡萄酒，Manhattan、Negroni 的必备改性酒。
descriptionEn: Aromatised fortified red wine, the essential modifier for Manhattan and Negroni.

descriptionZh: 加香干白葡萄酒，Martini、Brooks Brothers 等搅拌型鸡尾酒的常配改性酒。
descriptionEn: Aromatised fortified white wine, the classic modifier for stirred gin classics like the Martini.

descriptionZh: 高端橙皮利口酒，Margarita、Sidecar、White Lady 等的标志性甜橙来源。
descriptionEn: Premium orange liqueur, the defining sweet-citrus modifier for Margarita, Sidecar and White Lady.

descriptionZh: 廉价橙皮利口酒，是 Cointreau 的经济替代，Cosmopolitan 配方中亦常见。
descriptionEn: Budget orange liqueur, a workhorse substitute for Cointreau in many Cosmopolitan recipes.

descriptionZh: 墨西哥咖啡利口酒，Espresso Martini 与 Black Russian 的灵魂。
descriptionEn: Mexican coffee liqueur, the soul of Espresso Martini and Black Russian.

descriptionZh: 意大利杏仁风味利口酒，Amaretto Sour、Paper Plane 的关键甜味来源。
descriptionEn: Italian almond-flavoured liqueur, the defining sweet modifier for Amaretto Sour and Paper Plane.

descriptionZh: 法国接骨木花利口酒，花香细腻，常用于现代花系鸡尾酒。
descriptionEn: French elderflower liqueur, used in modern floral recipes and to lighten a Tom Collins.

descriptionZh: 法国草药利口酒，含 27 种香料和蜂蜜，Vieux Carré、Singapore Sling 的关键一环。
descriptionEn: French herbal-honey liqueur, the secret weapon of Vieux Carré and Singapore Sling.

descriptionZh: 130 草药配方的高度利口酒，Last Word、Naked & Famous 等的灵魂。
descriptionEn: 130-botanical high-proof herbal liqueur, the defining modifier for Last Word and Naked & Famous.

descriptionZh: 比绿查特更甜、花香更明显的版本，常用于 Naked & Famous 等平衡型现代经典。
descriptionEn: Sweeter, more floral sibling of Green Chartreuse, used in Naked & Famous and lighter herbal drinks.

descriptionZh: 马拉斯加樱桃酿制的干型利口酒，Last Word、Aviation 等的灵魂。
descriptionEn: Dry cherry liqueur from marasca cherries, the defining modifier of Last Word and Aviation.

descriptionZh: 黑莓果泥利口酒，Bramble 顶部浇淋的核心元素。
descriptionEn: Blackberry liqueur drizzled over crushed ice to create the signature look of a Bramble.

descriptionZh: 蜂蜜与苏格兰威士忌调和的利口酒，Rusty Nail 的标志。
descriptionEn: Scotch-honey liqueur, the defining modifier of the Rusty Nail.

descriptionZh: 意大利极苦药草酒，Hanky Panky 的灵魂，常作整餐的消化酒。
descriptionEn: Italian intensely bitter amaro, the defining modifier of Hanky Panky.

descriptionZh: 丹麦樱桃利口酒，Singapore Sling 的传统甜味来源。
descriptionEn: Danish cherry liqueur, the historic sweet modifier of the Singapore Sling.

descriptionZh: 杏仁与橙花水调制的糖浆，Mai Tai、Tiki 类鸡尾酒的灵魂甜味。
descriptionEn: Almond-rose-orange-blossom syrup, the defining sweetener of the Mai Tai and many tiki drinks.

descriptionZh: 含丁香、生姜与杏仁的加勒比糖浆，Zombie、Corn 'n' Oil 的标志。
descriptionEn: Caribbean syrup with clove, ginger and almond, the signature sweetener of the Zombie and Corn 'n' Oil.

descriptionZh: 干型起泡酒，French 75、Champagne Cocktail、Aperol Spritz 的顶部加注。
descriptionEn: Dry sparkling wine, used to top French 75, Champagne Cocktail and Aperol Spritz.

descriptionZh: 加香加味加强葡萄酒，Corpse Reviver #2、Vesper 的关键成分。
descriptionEn: Aromatised fortified white wine, the defining modifier of the Corpse Reviver #2 and Vesper.

descriptionZh: 现榨柠檬汁，几乎所有酸型鸡尾酒的酸基来源。
descriptionEn: Freshly squeezed lemon juice, the standard acid for sours, fizzes and daisies.

descriptionZh: 现榨青柠汁，Daiquiri、Margarita、Mojito 的酸基来源。
descriptionEn: Freshly squeezed lime juice, the acid backbone for Daiquiri, Margarita and Mojito.

descriptionZh: 现榨橙汁，主要用于 Hurricane、Mimosa 等果汁型鸡尾酒。
descriptionEn: Freshly squeezed orange juice, used in Hurricane and other juice-forward classics.

descriptionZh: 现榨西柚汁，Paloma、Hemingway Daiquiri 的微苦酸基。
descriptionEn: Freshly squeezed grapefruit juice, the bitter-citrus base for Paloma and Hemingway Daiquiri.

descriptionZh: 现榨或冷压菠萝汁，Singapore Sling、Jungle Bird 的热带灵魂。
descriptionEn: Fresh or cold-pressed pineapple juice, the tropical heart of Singapore Sling and Jungle Bird.

descriptionZh: 无糖蔓越莓汁，Cosmopolitan、Cape Codder 的标准。
descriptionEn: Unsweetened cranberry juice, the standard for Cosmopolitan and Cape Codder.

descriptionZh: 白砂糖与水 1:1 加热溶化，酸型鸡尾酒的标准甜味来源。
descriptionEn: Equal parts sugar and water by weight, the standard sweetener for sours and fizzes.

descriptionZh: 糖水比 2:1 的浓糖浆，老式鸡尾酒（Old Fashioned、Manhattan）常用。
descriptionEn: Two parts sugar to one part water, the richer sweetener preferred for stirred classics.

descriptionZh: 蜂蜜与水 1:1 稀释，Penicillin、Bee's Knees 的蜂蜜甜味来源。
descriptionEn: Honey thinned with equal water, the sweet-honey modifier for Penicillin and Bee's Knees.

descriptionZh: 稀释的龙舌兰糖浆，Margarita 与现代龙舌兰类鸡尾酒的甜味来源。
descriptionEn: Diluted agave nectar, the natural sweetener for tequila-forward sours and modern agave drinks.

descriptionZh: 石榴汁与糖的传统糖浆，Jack Rose、Hurricane、Singapore Sling 的甜味与红色来源。
descriptionEn: Pomegranate-sugar syrup, the defining red sweetener for Jack Rose, Hurricane and Singapore Sling.

descriptionZh: 鲜姜熬煮的糖浆，Penicillin 的核心辣甜来源。
descriptionEn: Fresh ginger-cooked syrup, the defining spicy-sweet modifier for the Penicillin.

descriptionZh: 最经典的芳香苦精，几乎所有搅拌型鸡尾酒都需要 2 dashes。
descriptionEn: The classic aromatic bitters, called for in two dashes across nearly all stirred classics.

descriptionZh: 橙皮配香料的苦精，Martini、Manhattan 关键一两 dash。
descriptionEn: Citrus-peel bitters essential to the classic Dry Martini and the Martinez.

descriptionZh: 新奥尔良风味苦精，Sazerac 必备的红色苦精。
descriptionEn: New Orleans anise-floral bitters, the defining modifier of the Sazerac.

descriptionZh: 含奎宁的碳酸饮料，Gin & Tonic 的核心。
descriptionEn: Quinine-laced sparkling water, the essential mixer for the Gin & Tonic.

descriptionZh: 中性碳酸水，Spritz、Tom Collins、Aperol Spritz 的顶部加注。
descriptionEn: Neutral sparkling water for topping Spritz, Tom Collins and other highballs.

descriptionZh: 姜味强于姜汁汽水的发酵碳酸饮料，Moscow Mule 与 Dark 'n' Stormy 的核心。
descriptionEn: Spicy fermented ginger soda, the defining mixer for Moscow Mule and Dark 'n' Stormy.

descriptionZh: 可乐，Cuba Libre、Rum & Coke 的传统搭配。
descriptionEn: Cola for the classic Rum & Coke and Cuba Libre.

descriptionZh: 一只鸡蛋的蛋清，Whiskey Sour、Pisco Sour、Ramos Gin Fizz 的绵密泡沫来源。
descriptionEn: One fresh egg white for the silky foam of Whiskey Sour, Pisco Sour and Ramos Gin Fizz.

descriptionZh: 鹰嘴豆罐头水，vegan 替代蛋清的起泡来源。
descriptionEn: Chickpea brine as a vegan egg-white substitute for foam.

descriptionZh: 新鲜薄荷叶，是 Mojito、Mint Julep、Southside 的香气主角。
descriptionEn: Fresh mint leaves, the aromatic lead of Mojito, Mint Julep and Southside.

descriptionZh: 新鲜罗勒叶，现代鸡尾酒如 Smash 系列常用。
descriptionEn: Fresh basil leaves for modern smash-style cocktails.

descriptionZh: 新鲜迷迭香，常用于冬季暖鸡尾酒与 gin 系香料酒。
descriptionEn: Fresh rosemary sprigs, common in winter gin and warming drinks.

descriptionZh: 新鲜黄瓜片，Pimm's Cup、Southside 夏季的清爽来源。
descriptionEn: Fresh cucumber slices, the cooling note of Pimm's Cup and summer drinks.

descriptionZh: 新鲜橙皮，Martini、Negroni 顶部喷香使用。
descriptionEn: Fresh orange peel, expressed over the surface of stirred classics like Martini and Negroni.

descriptionZh: 新鲜柠檬皮，常用于 martini-style 鸡尾酒的喷香装饰。
descriptionEn: Fresh lemon peel for the bright citrus oil of a martini-style drink.

descriptionZh: Maraschino 酒渍的红樱桃，Manhattan、Old Fashioned 的传统装饰。
descriptionEn: Red Maraschino-soaked cherries for the classic Manhattan and Old Fashioned garnish.

descriptionZh: 盐水浸的鸡尾酒橄榄，Dry Martini 的传统装饰。
descriptionEn: Brine-soaked cocktail olives, the traditional Martini garnish.

descriptionZh: Luxardo 糖渍黑樱桃，Manhattan、Old Fashioned 的高级装饰。
descriptionEn: Luxardo-style dark cocktail cherries, the premium garnish for stirred classics.

descriptionZh: 完整的薄荷枝，顶部轻拍释放香气后装饰。
descriptionEn: Whole mint sprig, slapped and placed as aromatic garnish.

descriptionZh: 一块方糖（约 4g），Old Fashioned 与 Sazerac 的传统甜味载体。
descriptionEn: One sugar cube (~4g), the historic sweetener for Old Fashioned and Sazerac.

descriptionZh: 细海盐，Margarita 杯边糖盐边与 Bloody Mary 调味常用。
descriptionEn: Fine sea salt for rims and Bloody Mary seasoning.

descriptionZh: 高度茴香风味烈酒，Sazerac 洗杯、Corpse Reviver 的灵魂。
descriptionEn: High-proof anise spirit used to rinse the Sazerac glass and anchor many classic recipes.

descriptionZh: 西柚味碳酸饮料，Paloma 的传统搭配。
descriptionEn: Grapefruit-flavoured sparkling soda, the traditional Paloma topper.

descriptionZh: 百香果糖浆，Hurricane、Hurricane-style tiki 鸡尾酒的核心。
descriptionEn: Passion fruit syrup, the tropical heart of the Hurricane and many tiki drinks.

descriptionZh: 英国草药利口酒，Pimm's Cup 的基酒。
descriptionEn: British herbal-fruit liqueur, the base of the Pimm's Cup.

descriptionZh: 黑莓利口酒，Bramble 的标志淋面酒。
descriptionEn: Blackberry liqueur, the signature float for the Bramble.

descriptionZh: 中性碳酸水，用于调高球杯鸡尾酒。
descriptionEn: Neutral sparkling water for highball dilution.

descriptionZh: 西西里苦味阿玛罗，比 Fernet 甜润的苦酒选择。
descriptionEn: Sicilian bitter amaro, a softer alternative to Fernet-Branca.

descriptionZh: 洋蓟风味苦酒，是 Italian-style 鸡尾酒的常见苦味来源。
descriptionEn: Artichoke-based bitter, the defining modifier of Italian bitter drinks.

descriptionZh: 肉桂枝，Old Fashioned 与冬季鸡尾酒的装饰兼搅拌棒。
descriptionEn: Cinnamon stick used as both garnish and stirrer for warming classics.

descriptionZh: 新鲜墨西哥辣椒片，现代 spicy 鸡尾酒提供辛香。
descriptionEn: Fresh jalapeño slices for the spicy heat of modern chilli cocktails.

descriptionZh: 高脂淡奶油，Brandy Alexander、Grasshopper 等奶基鸡尾酒的传统材料。
descriptionEn: High-fat cream for the classic cream-based Brandy Alexander and Grasshopper.

descriptionZh: 新鲜百里香，现代鸡尾酒中的优雅草本点缀。
descriptionEn: Fresh thyme as the herbal accent of modern stirred or shaken drinks.

descriptionZh: 青柠皮，Margarita、Daiquiri 的喷香装饰。
descriptionEn: Lime peel for the bright citrus oil on a Margarita or Daiquiri.

descriptionZh: 紫罗兰花瓣利口酒，赋予 Aviation 标志性的紫蓝色与花香。
descriptionEn: Violet-flower liqueur that gives the Aviation its signature floral lift and pale blue-purple hue.

descriptionZh: 黑刺李浸泡金酒而成的英式利口酒，Charlie Chaplin 等历史名方的关键。
descriptionEn: British liqueur made by steeping sloe berries in gin, the defining modifier of the Charlie Chaplin.

descriptionZh: 杏子果香利口酒，Charlie Chaplin、Army & Navy 等历史名方的重要甜味来源。
descriptionEn: Apricot-flavoured brandy liqueur, the sweet-fruity modifier of Charlie Chaplin and other pre-prohibition classics.

descriptionZh: 苦橙花蒸馏水，几滴即可赋予橙花香气，是 Ramos Gin Fizz 的灵魂。
descriptionEn: Distilled bitter-orange-blossom water, a few drops define the iconic aroma of the Ramos Gin Fizz.

descriptionZh: 发酵咸鲜酱汁，Bloody Mary 的标志调味。
descriptionEn: Fermented savoury sauce, the defining umami seasoning of the Bloody Mary.

descriptionZh: 新鲜西柚皮，Paloma 与 Hemingway Daiquiri 的喷香装饰。
descriptionEn: Fresh grapefruit peel, the bitter-citrus garnish of Paloma and Hemingway Daiquiri.

descriptionZh: 法国诺曼底产区的苹果白兰地，是 Angel Face、Corpse Reviver #1 等 20 世纪鸡尾酒的法式基底。
descriptionEn: French apple brandy from Normandy, the French base of Angel Face, Corpse Reviver #1 and other 20th-century classics.

descriptionZh: 陈年桶养牙买加朗姆，是 Mai Tai、Airmail、Three Dots and a Dash 等 tiki 与海明威经典的灵魂基酒。
descriptionEn: Aged Jamaican pot-still rum, the soul of Mai Tai, Airmail, Three Dots and a Dash and other tiki classics.

descriptionZh: 无色薄荷利口酒，Stinger 与 Grasshopper 的传统配方。
descriptionEn: Clear mint liqueur, the traditional base of the Stinger and Grasshopper.

descriptionZh: 牙买加多香果浸泡的利口酒，三点与破折号、Jet Pilot 的 tiki 香料灵魂。
descriptionEn: Jamaican allspice-infused liqueur, the spice backbone of Three Dots and a Dash and Jet Pilot.

descriptionZh: 蓝色橙皮利口酒，Blue Hawaiian 的视觉灵魂。
descriptionEn: Blue-tinted orange liqueur, the visual signature of the Blue Hawaiian.

descriptionZh: 覆盆子果泥糖浆，Clover Club 的标志性红色来源。
descriptionEn: Crushed raspberry syrup, the iconic pink of the Clover Club.

descriptionZh: 葡萄牙产加强葡萄酒，Porto Flip、Millionaire 的红色基酒。
descriptionEn: Portuguese fortified wine, the red base of Porto Flip and the Millionaire.

descriptionZh: 西班牙最干型的雪利酒，Bamboo 等开胃酒的基础。
descriptionEn: Spain's driest sherry, the bone-dry base of the Bamboo and other aperitif classics.

descriptionZh: 介于菲诺与欧罗洛索之间的琥珀色雪利酒，Sherry Cobbler、Adonis、Fog Cutter 的灵魂。
descriptionEn: Amber sherry between fino and oloroso, the soul of Sherry Cobbler, Adonis and the Fog Cutter's float.

descriptionZh: 高脂厚椰子奶油，Piña Colada、Blue Hawaiian 的热带奶感来源。
descriptionEn: Thick high-fat coconut cream, the tropical body of Piña Colada and Blue Hawaiian.

descriptionZh: 意大利干型起泡酒，Bellini、Mimosa、Hugo Spritz、Negroni Sbagliato 的轻盈气泡源。
descriptionEn: Italian dry sparkling wine, the bubbles of Bellini, Mimosa, Hugo Spritz and Negroni Sbagliato.

descriptionZh: 白桃果泥，Bellini 与 Peach Julep 的柔甜果香。
descriptionEn: White peach purée, the silky fruit of the Bellini and Peach Julep.

descriptionZh: 桃子利口酒，Peach Tree、Peach Blossom、Derby 等果香鸡尾酒的常用基酒。
descriptionEn: Peach liqueur, the stone-fruit base of Peach Tree, Peach Blossom and the Derby.

descriptionZh: 干红葡萄酒，New York Sour 与 Boston Sour 顶部浮酒的层次来源。
descriptionEn: Dry red wine floated atop New York and Boston Sours to add colour and tannin.

descriptionZh: 干白葡萄酒，Kir 开胃酒的底色；常用勃艮第或长相思。
descriptionEn: Dry white wine, the base of the Kir aperitif; typically a crisp Bourgogne or Sauvignon Blanc.

descriptionZh: 新鲜蛋黄，Golden Fizz 与 Porto Flip 的乳化稠度来源。
descriptionEn: Fresh egg yolk, the emulsifier of the Golden Fizz and Porto Flip.

descriptionZh: 淡色拉格啤酒，Shandy 高球的啤酒侧。
descriptionEn: Pale lager, the beer side of the Shandy highball.

descriptionZh: 柠檬味汽水，Shandy 高球的汽水侧。
descriptionEn: Lemon soda, the fizzy side of the Shandy highball.

descriptionZh: 干型苹果西打，Stone Fence 的传统酒底。
descriptionEn: Dry apple cider, the traditional top of the Stone Fence.

descriptionZh: 肉桂糖浆，Don the Beachcomber Donn's Mix 2:1 配方（西柚汁+肉桂糖浆）的灵魂。
descriptionEn: Cinnamon-infused simple syrup, the spice backbone of Donn Beach's Donn's Mix (2:1 grapefruit to cinnamon syrup).

descriptionZh: 无色可可利口酒，20th Century 与 Grasshopper 等 20 世纪甜型鸡尾酒的传统配料。
descriptionEn: White cocoa liqueur, the chocolate base of 20th Century and other 20th-century dessert cocktails.

descriptionZh: 法国黑加仑利口酒，Kir 与 Kir Royale 标志性的红色与果香来源。
descriptionEn: French blackcurrant liqueur, the signature colour and fruit of Kir and Kir Royale.

descriptionZh: 现磨肉豆蔻，Porto Flip 等「Flip」类鸡尾酒的传统顶部装饰。
descriptionEn: Freshly grated nutmeg, the traditional top-sprinkle of Porto Flip and other 'flip' family cocktails.

descriptionZh: 细砂糖，Brandy Crusta 等杯边糖边的撒粉原料。
descriptionEn: Fine granulated sugar for sugar-rimmed classics like the Brandy Crusta.
